candidate_selection.rule: rows classed confirm_candidate against x0, by (F_exit, label); greedily the best, then the next whose node AND year both differ from every pick

not_settled_review.rule: 3 consecutive not_settled confirmations, or not_settled on more than 25% of >= 4 confirmations (integration ruling 5)

band_measure_information_only.rule: v1 measure: certified rows with |F_exit(x) - F_exit(x0)| <= e_EV over every row; recorded beside the deciding measure, read by no decision (Planner decision P1)

efficiency.rule: fraction of the screen and ladder rows whose class against x0 at exit is NOT worse (confirm_candidate + unresolved; Planner decision P1) (denominator: every screen and ladder row, uncertified ones included); > 1/2 -> every later poll evaluation runs directly to K_EV (settled_direct), else exit_then_confirm

ladder.rule: best duration = duration of the certified screen plan with the lowest F_exit (ties by label); two best node-years = lowest F_exit among certified screen plans at that duration (ties by label); P in ladder_zp at that duration; a ladder point the lattice refuses is skipped

log: efficiency rule: 22 of 22 not worse against x0 {'confirm_candidate': 16, 'worse': 0, 'unresolved': 6, 'uncertified': 0, 'harness_error': 0} -> settled_direct (v1 band measure, information only: 12 in band)

table.classification: classify_exit(x, x0, R, e_floor = e_EV); e = max(e_EV, bar_x + bar_x0)
table.objective_convention: F = I(x) + gross_operational_cost - TV credit, EUR of total discounted planning cost; dF_exit = F_exit(x) - F_exit(x0)
